entries.name: parcel 4471
lines: to the radio repair, main street. by ten.

lines.text: on his bench now. he didn't open it. he didn't need to.

entries.name: my radio
lines: needs a valve. the left one's dead.

lines.text: it works. a voice under the static. whose?

entries.name: the fixer
lines: radio shop, main street. sees what I see now.
I owe him one favour. he didn't say what.

entries.name: the woman at the cradle
lines: real. wire-thin. nobody looks at her.

entries.name: under the shop window
lines: a man asleep. not there for them. who is he?

entries.name: who ran the radio shop before Care?
make it promise, don't just ask.
